purpose: Durable progress record for the Jastrow/Krupnik meaning-equivalence audit.

baseline.realReaderPhraseExtractorAudit: All 1249 retained whole-gloss mappings and all 63 retained alternative-level mappings are checked against original Krupnik glosses and the real Chromium JastrowReadingView.phrases extractor.
baseline.distinctSensePolicy: preserve distinct senses; never merge by headword or token overlap alone
baseline.sourcePolicy: each accepted mapping must be grounded in original source records and exact reader-displayed phrases
baseline.exactGlossNormalization: Deterministic canonical matching now consolidates complete gloss lists that differ only by punctuation, alternative order, leading articles, or coordinated active/passive infinitive markers; verb voice and word order within each alternative remain significant.
baseline.alternativeLevelPolicy: A source-scoped alternative mapping may consolidate one exact Jastrow phrase with one alternative embedded in a longer Krupnik gloss. Unmatched alternatives from that original gloss remain a separate result; More detail retains the complete original source wording.
baseline.synonymGroupPolicy: Curated synonym groups are grounded in explicit source gloss lists, scoped to the same headword, and merge only when every alternative on both sides belongs to the same group. Coordinated verb glosses may omit a repeated 'to'; the matcher restores it only when the first alternative is an infinitive, preserving noun/verb distinctions.
baseline.homonymPolicy: If both source headwords explicitly carry different Roman or superscript Arabic homonym numbers, they are not compatible for consolidation. A numbered headword may still match an unnumbered counterpart, since one dictionary may omit the numbering.

historicalCheckpoint.note: The earlier 29/43 checkpoint did not record the 43 candidate identifiers or the 29 completed identifiers. Do not infer completion from the number of data shards or from the reviewed-pair count.

reconstruction.note: These physical shard counts do not equal the historical 43 audit batches. The candidate inventory must be regenerated from shared consonantal headwords, original glosses, and the real reader phrase extractor.

rules: Generate candidates only where Jastrow and Krupnik records share an attested consonantal headword or alias.
Use only phrases emitted by JastrowReadingView.phrases for Jastrow-side meanings.
Compare individual senses, not whole-entry summaries.
Exclude exact-identical glosses already handled by ordinary exact matching.
Record every candidate as pending, accepted, rejected-distinct-sense, or rejected-not-displayed.
Keep original source references and exact source wording for every decision.
Candidate discovery uses token overlap only to rank a review queue; it never automatically merges senses.

candidateInventory.status: Regenerating after 63 reviewed alternative-level mappings, synonym-group expansion, and explicit homonym safeguards.
candidateInventory.note: The candidate generator now compares each Jastrow phrase and Krupnik gloss at individual alternative level, ranks exact alternatives first, records up to ten alternative-pair comparisons, excludes reviewed whole-gloss and alternative pairs, and rejects conflicting explicit homonym numbers. Candidate overlap is still review evidence only.

displayConsolidation.policy: For a manually reviewed or exact-equivalent group, display the union of unique alternatives from all source glosses, in source order, while retaining complete original source entries in More detail.
displayConsolidation.synonymSafety: A curated synonym group may consolidate whole glosses only when every comma/semicolon-separated alternative on both sides belongs to the same curated synonym group; a shared synonym cannot absorb an unrelated extra sense.

safeguards: Alternative mapping is scoped to exact source record IDs and exact source phrase.
Only the explicitly matched alternative is placed in the shared result.
Original complete source gloss is preserved in More detail.
Every Jastrow phrase is checked against the real Chromium reader extractor.
Headword compatibility is still required by the merge layer.
All alternatives in both glosses must belong to the same curated synonym group.
Coordinated infinitive markers are normalized only when the first alternative is an infinitive.

homonymSafeguards.scope: runtime meaning merge and candidate inventory generation
homonymSafeguards.rationale: A shared consonantal spelling is not enough when both dictionaries explicitly distinguish different numbered homonyms.

secondAlternativeReviewedTranche.rationale: Each pair has the same individual meaning alternative in both source records, with matching consonantal headword forms and no conflicting explicit grammatical labels or numbered homonyms. Alternative-level bucketing consolidates only the matched phrase; every unmatched phrase remains a separate result, and More detail preserves the full original source gloss.
